<repaired_code>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using pii = pair<int, int>;
using vi = vector<int>;
using vii = vector<pii>;
using viii = vector<vector<int>>;

const int dy[4] = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
const int dx[4] = {0, -1, 0, 1};
const int INF = 1000;

int n, t, Zx, Zy, dist[10][10];
string grid[2][10];

struct FlowEdge {
    int to, cap, rev;
    FlowEdge(int t, int c, int r) : to(t), cap(c), rev(r) {}
};

vector<vector<FlowEdge>> g;
vector<int> lvl, it;

void add_edge(int u, int v, int c) {
    g[u].emplace_back(v, c, g[v].size());
    g[v].emplace_back(u, 0, g[u].size() - 1);
}

void bfs_level(int s) {
    fill(lvl.begin(), lvl.end(), -1);
    queue<int> q;
    lvl[s] = 0;
    q.push(s);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (auto& e : g[u]) {
            if (e.cap > 0 && lvl[e.to] < 0) {
                lvl[e.to] = lvl[u] + 1;
                q.push(e.to);
            }
        }
    }
}

int dfs_flow(int u, int sink, int f) {
    if (u == sink) return f;
    for (int& i = it[u]; i < g[u].size(); ++i) {
        FlowEdge& e = g[u][i];
        if (e.cap > 0 && lvl[u] < lvl[e.to]) {
            int pushed = dfs_flow(e.to, sink, min(f, e.cap));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.cap -= pushed;
                g[e.to][e.rev].cap += pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int max_flow(int s, int t) {
    int flow = 0;
    lvl.assign(g.size(), -1);
    it.assign(g.size(), 0);
    while (true) {
        bfs_level(s);
        if (lvl[t] < 0) break;
        fill(it.begin(), it.end(), 0);
        int pushed;
        while ((pushed = dfs_flow(s, t, INF)) > 0) flow += pushed;
    }
    return flow;
}

bool reachable(int sy, int sx, int gy, int gx) {
    if (grid[0][sy][sx] == 'Y' || grid[0][gy][gx] == 'Y') return false;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
            dist[i][j] = INF;
    dist[sy][sx] = 0;
    queue<pii> q;
    q.emplace(sy, sx);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int y = q.front().first, x = q.front().second; q.pop();
        if (y == gy && x == gx) return dist[y][x] <= t;
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int ny = y + dy[d], nx = x + dx[d];
            if (ny < 0 || nx < 0 || ny >= n || nx >= n) continue;
            if (grid[0][ny][nx] == 'Y') continue;
            if (dist[ny][nx] != INF) continue;
            dist[ny][nx] = dist[y][x] + 1;
            if (dist[ny][nx] <= t) {
                q.emplace(ny, nx);
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

void solve() {
    cin >> n >> t;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> grid[0][i];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> grid[1][i];

    vi px, py, cx, cy;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (grid[0][i][j] >= '1' && grid[0][i][j] <= '9') {
                py.push_back(i);
                px.push_back(j);
            }
            if (grid[1][i][j] >= '1' && grid[1][i][j] <= '9') {
                cy.push_back(i);
                cx.push_back(j);
            }
            if (grid[0][i][j] == 'Z') {
                Zy = i;
                Zx = j;
            }
            dist[i][j] = INF;
        }

    // BFS from reactor to compute infection times
    dist[Zy][Zx] = 0;
    queue<pii> q;
    q.emplace(Zy, Zx);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int y = q.front().first, x = q.front().second; q.pop();
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int ny = y + dy[d], nx = x + dx[d];
            if (ny < 0 || nx < 0 || ny >= n || nx >= n) continue;
            if (grid[0][ny][nx] == 'Y') continue; // reactor is impassable
            if (dist[ny][nx] != INF) continue;
            dist[ny][nx] = dist[y][x] + 1;
            q.emplace(ny, nx);
        }
    }

    int m = px.size() + cx.size() + 2;
    g.assign(m, vector<FlowEdge>());
    
    // Source to scientists (reactors)
    for (int i = 0; i < px.size(); ++i)
        add_edge(m - 2, i, grid[0][py[i]][px[i]] - '0');
    
    // Labs to sink
    for (int i = 0; i < cx.size(); ++i)
        add_edge(i + px.size(), m - 1, grid[1][cy[i]][cx[i]] - '0');

    // Scientists to labs if reachable within time
    for (int i = 0; i < px.size(); ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < cx.size(); ++j)
            if (reachable(py[i], px[i], cy[j], cx[j]))
                add_edge(i, j + px.size(), 1);

    cout << max_flow(m - 2, m - 1) << endl;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    solve();
    return 0;
}
